help.goal: Collect as few points as you can. When somebody hits 100 the lowest score wins.
steps: Tap 3 cards, then tap Pass to send them on.
The 2♣ opens the hand; tap a card to play it.
Follow the suit that was led; only legal cards stay tappable.
The highest card of the led suit takes the trick and its points.
Play 13 tricks, read the summary, and the next hand deals itself.
notes: Passing rotates each hand: left, right, across, then a hand with no passing at all.
Every heart costs 1 point and the queen of spades costs 13. Nobody may lead a heart until hearts are broken.
Shoot the moon: take all 26 points yourself and you score 0 while everyone else takes 26.
